message: The other night, we had a little power outage, and my friend Sarah went into full panic mode. While I was calmly gathering my flashlights and power banks, she was frantically searching for candles. I had to remind her that we could manage just fine without them! We ended up cozying up with some snacks and a game by lantern light, and it turned into a fun night. It just goes to show that a little calm can turn a hiccup into a memorable moment. What’s your go-to plan for an unexpected blackout?
